Package fr.upsaclay.bibs.pacman.model.actors

Interface Ghost

All Superinterfaces:
Actor
public interface Ghost extends Actor
The interface representing the ghosts of the game. A ghost is an actor, just like pacman, but it also has some extra methods. (not used before Step 2)
